summary:
Comprehensive UI/UX Refactoring Plan for CraveDrop Marketplace:
- Consolidates redundant mobile bottom navigation and floating dock to prevent touch target collisions
- Implements real live browser geolocation with permission handling and fallback address resolution
- Overhauls color contrast, dark/light theme consistency, and typography hierarchy across all screens
- Enhances CartDrawer, RestaurantList, RestaurantMenuModal, LoginPage, and UserAccountPage with accessible states and touch-friendly controls
